dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Nothing beats a warm and cozy hot spring...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Just half an hour in a hot spring is enough to get rid of all the fatigue that accumulates during training and battle.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Do you mind if I take a dip now? Ooh! You wanna join me?
